notes.title: Pioneerz 2?
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I'm the creator of Pioneerz and Little Kingdom 2
I'm working on a new action RPG again, probably Pionnerz 2.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36635930/1683177d8f0ae48b53fc91ba21b450ae587e6059.png[/img]

The map generator has been improved a lot, here's a 400*400 map, we can see different biomes, grass, mountain, desert, ice, lake...
It's huge (the coloured hexes are a player's starting position) and will allow me to make tons of things!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36635930/c70e14e7c0cce8a439bfc15187a8ea1104b033f6.png[/img]

It looks like this in the game, it's pretty empty at the moment, with just floor tiles and some decoration.
But exploring can be fun, thanks to the natural obstacles.

Here's the minimap showing what we explored.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36635930/d9a92a7fc8f4074d2887a36a1407626b4319fec8.png[/img]


Next month I will start creating biomes specific plants and monsters.
See you later!
Cutandreil

notes.title: Small fixe v1.52
notes.content:
A bug has been found, carnivore were making baby too fast making the town dying at the beginning of the game.
It's now corrected!
So no more death in 5 minute, and no win in 15 ^^
The game should be a little bit easier, now you can take the time to explore and hunt strong beast!
